To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the sensitive dynamics response signals of car-body vertical acceleration, yaw acceleration, yaw velocity, yaw rate, car-body vertical displacement, yaw displacement and yaw angle are respectively proposed to detect and locating different bogie suspension components failures.
the dynamic responses of car body, bogies and wheelsets are significantly different when the suspension components are damaged or failed.
the sensitive fault feature factors of primary vertical damper, air spring and yaw damper failure can be obtained by analyzing the dynamic response signals in time and frequency domain.

the dynamic behavior of CR380B type high-speed vehicle with suspension component failure.

the fault feature factors to detecting and locating the primary and secondary suspension component failures of CRH380A type high speed vehicle, which provides theoretical support for the development of the fault detection and location technology of suspension component failures.
the fault diagnosis of suspension components in the CRH380B high speed vehicle.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed method is effective to detect and locate the suspension component failures.

the primary vertical damber fault can be detected by monitoring the vertical acceleration of bogie frame, the air spring fault can be detected through the vertical acceleration of car body, and the yaw damber fault can also be detected by monitoring yaw rate of car body.
the primary vertical damber failure, air spring and the yaw damber failure can be effectively detected and located by using the sensitive dynamic response signals of bogie and vehicle system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the dynamic simulation model of high speed vehicle for locating suspension component failures can be established by using the SIMPACK software.
the dynamic response signals and the sensitive fault feature factors of the vehicle system are very important for detecting and locating suspension component failures.

the dynamic simulation model of high speed vehicle for locating and detecting the suspension component failures can be established in SIMPACK software, and the sensitive dynamics response signals for the primary vertical dampr failure, air spring and the yaw dampr failure of high speed vehicle can be obtained by dynamic simulations, which can be used to detect and locate the suspension component failures of the high speed vehicle.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the proposed method has a good performance for detecting and locating different suspension component failures of CRH380 type high speed vehicle, which is of great significance for improving the safety of the high speed vehicle.
the proposed method can effectively detect and locate suspension component failures of high speed train, and the method is also applicable for other high speed trains with similar structure.

the sensitive dynamics response signals of the vehicle system can be used as the sensitive fault feature factors for the detection and location of the suspension component failures of high speed vehicle.
